body: Can you provide instructions to test the integration. I'm trying to replicate what you are showing in your screen recording.

> Can you provide instructions to test the integration. I'm trying to replicate what you are showing in your screen recording.

- Build with enabled AccessKit (running `python ./misc/scripts/install_accesskit.py` before build should be sufficient).
- Enable TalkBack on the device (https://support.google.com/accessibility/android/answer/6007100)
- Basic controls are: tap to select element, double tap to activate (or if it is controlled by mouse via `scrcpy` like on screen recording: hover to select, click to activate).

From the log, the crash occurs after a hover event so that may be hard to reproduce on a phone without a connected mouse or stylus to generate a hover event.

Still was not able to reproduce the crash on any device (neither with touch, not with scrcpy emulated mouse, nor with directly connected mouse). Will try emulator later.
@bruvzg Any updates on this PR? Were you able to reproduce the crash?
I was not able to reproduce the crash, neither on simulator nor on real devices.
Actually the latest crash experienced by @m4gr3d is probably a bug in the AccessKit Android adapter. See the fix [here](https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit/pull/803).

> Actually the latest crash experienced by @m4gr3d is probably a bug in the AccessKit Android adapter. See the fix [here](https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit/pull/803).

@bruvzg will you be able to apply the fix ahead of the feature freeze?

> will you be able to apply the fix ahead of the feature freeze?

Nothing in this PR should need changing, we use separate repo for custom AccessKit builds - https://github.com/godotengine/godot-accesskit-c-static

I'll test it on Saturday (and update our custom build repo).

I have tested it with desktop AVD, and was able to reproduce the crash. I can confirm it is fixed by https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit/pull/803

To avoid version mismatches, I'll probably wait for next official [accesskit-c](https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit-c) release before updating our custom build repo. It will also require a tiny, non-platform specific change to the main repo due to API renames, I will do a separate follow-up PR once it is updated. Should not really matter if this part is done before freeze or not, since AccessKit version update is not a new feature.
[accesskit-c 0.23.1](https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit-c/releases/tag/0.23.1) released. It contains a few fixes and improvements for Android, including the one discussed here.
